comparisonPolicy.evidence: Use the CI summary for its exact pinned source; the candidate run is not ordinary comparison evidence.

review.method: Root individually opened all13 changed originals in original detail. Two settings images and all8 site originals matched the10 images individually opened earlier in this task;149 remaining PNGs exactly matched the prior per-file review receipt. All172 current artifact/Git blobs and the export patch were verified.
review.scope: Visual review of isolated browser simulations; not physical hardware, vendor cloud or Unity-client acceptance. Full ordinary comparison remains the merge gate.
nonBlockingObservations: English singular-count labels retain plural nouns in a few panels.
Long native select labels truncate; full content headings remain visible.
Wide tables use explicit horizontal scroll containers.
